missing_critical_skill.description: Deduction for each absent skill explicitly classified as mandatory/required.

mandatory_certification_missing.description: Deduction when a required professional license (e.g. CPA, PE) is missing.

major_experience_gap.description: Deduction when detected relevant tenure is less than 50% of mandatory requirement.

mandatory_degree_missing.description: Deduction when highest degree attained is below mandatory educational minimum.

major_seniority_mismatch.description: Deduction for acute seniority tier divergence (> 2 hierarchy levels difference).

unauthorized_work_constraint.description: Deduction when a stated legal constraint (e.g. citizenship/clearance) cannot be verified.
